findings.title: Table contents can't be verified against the code from this diff
findings.explanation: The PR claims to list every environment variable the API reads, with its defaults. The diff only touches the README, so I can't confirm that the list is complete or that the defaults and 'Used by' paths match src/db.ts, src/server.ts and src/lib/provider.ts. Before merging, grep for process.env usage (and any config or validation module) and check that every variable, required flag and default matches. Variables such as NODE_ENV, LOG_LEVEL or any other optional settings are easy to miss.

findings.title: Confirm the PAYMENT_PROVIDER_URL default is intended
findings.explanation: The documented default is the placeholder host `https://api.payments.example`. If the code really defaults to this, a deployment that forgets to set the variable will fail at runtime instead of at startup. If the default isn't real, the doc is misleading. Either make the variable required or document the actual production and sandbox URLs.

findings.title: Add a description column
findings.explanation: The table says which file uses each variable but not what it does or what format it takes (for example, the DATABASE_URL connection string format, or whether PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY is a secret that must not be committed). A short Description column would make it more useful to people setting up deployments. Writing `none` as the default for required variables could also be replaced with `—` for clarity.
